ivf_trainset_stride_off.note: Rollback arm: the coarse quantizer trains on every row again. Default trains on rows 0,s,2s,... with s = max(1, n // max(min(n//2, 256*n_lists), n_lists)), exact integers, every column (device + host). Moves IDENTICAL bits of ivf, ivf-euclidean, ivf-filter, par-ivf and the IVF-PQ coarse step; recall gate against cuVS required.

kmeans_lazy_shift_idn_off.bits_change: only for lazy_shift fits (IVF coarse quantizer + its k-means|| recluster, IVF-PQ codebooks) that converge before max_iter; device and host columns move together
kmeans_lazy_shift_idn_off.note: Rollback arm: IDENTICAL reads the Lloyd shift every iteration (one sync each). FAST on NVIDIA/AMD also takes the lazy read now; MOJOLEARN_IVF_KMEANS_LAZY_SHIFT_OFF turns it off in every mode.

ann:ivf.route: IVFIndex.fit -> ivf_flat_build_resident (strided trainset, k-means|| + lazy Lloyd, predict, device CSR kept) -> handle; search -> ivf_flat_index_search on the handle
